Reruns the tag-release run the mint just started, addressed by the id that start returned. The release verdict is still read from the tag and the attested release assets, never from this lookup.

The scheduled pin wave (scripts/run-workflow-pin-wave.sh) reads the exact landed main SHA's four release jobs immediately before advancing one consumer. This is bounded rollout admission, not durable release evidence. Renewed once after it lapsed on 2026-10-15, because the wave still depends on it; replace it with immutable evidence or remove it before this expiration.
